description: This header file declares functions related to JavaScript bindings for the AAMP module within the WPEFramework WebKit browser extension. It primarily provides function declarations for loading/unloading JS bindings and setting HTTP headers.

methods.name: LoadJSBindings
methods.description: Initializes or loads JavaScript bindings into a given WebKit script world and frame.

methods.name: UnloadJSBindings
methods.description: Removes or unloads JavaScript bindings from a given WebKit script world and frame.

methods.name: SetHttpHeaders
methods.description: Sets HTTP headers based on provided JSON string.
